text:
releasebot: Hotfix request: kv-cache-racefix -> canary. Window 03:45-04:00 UTC. Impact: intermittent 503s on embed endpoint. Requesting expedited approval for fast rollback readiness.

nina: oncall here. tagging eng + sre. Can we get a quick 'rollback-ready' signoff so we can push to canary and cut to 25% if burn-in looks good? Need to minimize outage window. :hourglass:

kai: eng +1. Patch: atomic cache write + TTL tweak. Image pinned to sha: e5f4d3b2. No schema or migration. We'll require ability to pin previous image within 60s.

sre_jules: I'll set thresholds. Abort if error-rate > 0.9% sustained 60s OR p99 > 280ms twice. I'll also prepare a traffic-silo to exclude EU until green.

nina: ops checklist in-thread:
```
- deploybot deploy --env=canary --image=redwood/hotfix:e5f4d3b2
- healthcheck: /health 30s x3
- monitors: embed-503-alert, kv-cache-errors
- rollback: deploybot rollback --to-sha=prev-cc11 (doc in runbook)
```

opsbot: preflight ok: image verified, cluster has capacity, quotas clear, no blocking alerts. SBOM attached.

deploybot: Canary deploy started on 2 pods (sha e5f4d3b2). Ephemeral channel opened.

sre_jules: watching dashboards. paging rules lowered for this thread.

opsbot: minute 1: errors 0.45%, p99 120ms. minute 2: errors 0.22%, p99 118ms. burn-in passed.

nina: proceeding to fastcut -> 25% prod traffic and pin image. Keep rollback hot.

kai: confirming rollback command ready and previous image sha noted. Eng on standby to run rollback if SRE asks.

opsbot: post-cut quick check: 2m avg errors 0.2%, p99 130ms. monitoring 10m. No pages.

sre_jules: EU still on stable; will greenlight global widen after EU metrics hold for 5m.

nina: release note (short): "hotfix: fix kv cache race causing transient 503s under heavy embed load; pinned image e5f4d3b2." Link: https://docs.internal/releases/1724902222-kv-fix

kai: approved as release owner.

sre_jules: if any threshold breaches I will trigger rollback immediately with deploybot rollback --to-sha=prev-cc11. Otherwise good to proceed.

opsbot: +10m observation: errors steady 0.17%, p99 135ms, no alerts.

nina: closing ephemeral channel in 5. Will follow up with final release train merge and full rollout. :white_check_mark:
